description_en: Queries the status of client certificates and server certificates by certificate serial number
description_zh: 通过证书的序列号查询客户端证书和服务端证书的状态信息
name: DescribeClientCertificateStatusForSerialNumber

parameters.help_en:
Certificate serial number of the client certificate or server certificate to query. Separate multiple serial numbers with commas (,).


You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/330884.html to query certificate serial numbers of all client certificates and server certificates
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的客户端证书或服务端证书的序列号。多个证书序列号之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。


您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/330884.html查询所有客户端与服务端证书的序列号
parameters.name: serial_number
